FacebookManagerCreatePost.name: FacebookManagerCreatePost
FacebookManagerCreatePost.summary: Create a new post on the user's timeline.

parameters.name: media_path
parameters.description: The local path of the media file to upload.

parameters.name: privacy_setting
parameters.description: One of ['public', 'friends', 'only me'], the privacy setting for the post. Default value is 'friends'.

returns.name: post_id
returns.description: The unique identifier of the created post.

GmailSendEmail.name: GmailSendEmail
GmailSendEmail.summary: Send an email to one or multiple recipients, with optional scheduling, cc, and bcc.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to send to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: cc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to carbon copy (CC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: bcc
parameters.description: A string of email addresses to blind carbon copy (BCC) to, separated by commas.

parameters.name: send_at
parameters.description: The scheduled date and time to send the email in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm'.

parameters.name: attachments
parameters.description: An array of local file paths of attachments.

returns.name: success
returns.description: An boolean value indicating whether the email was sent successfully.

MessengerSendMessage.name: MessengerSendMessage
MessengerSendMessage.summary: Sends a text message to a specified user.

parameters.name: recipient_id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the recipient or the group chat.

returns.name: message_id
returns.description: The unique identifier of the sent message.
